query:
SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ca.status, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM accounts_receivable ar
JOIN collection_actions ca ON ca.receivableId = ar.id
WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < CURDATE()
AND ar.tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO')
GROUP BY ar.id, ar.cliente, ca.status
HAVING cnt > 1
LIMIT 10;
